page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance configured with 32 vCPUs across 16 physical cores and 128 GB of RAM. Driven by Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz, this x86_64 architecture instance provides dedicated CPU allocation on a KVM hypervisor. The hardware profile exhibits a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, supported by L1 data cache of 32 KB, L2 cache of 1.0 MB per core, and 33 MB of shared L3 cache. Advanced vector extensions including AVX and AVX-512F are present. The instance features 15 Gbps baseline network bandwidth and does not include local storage.

Benchmark evaluations indicate a performance profile defined by strong multi-core scaling alongside modest per-core throughput. Single-core tests, such as stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core, register in the lower 25th percentile of performance. Conversely, multi-core benchmarks show average results, with stress-ng multi-core scoring 23,406.46 and PassMark CPU reaching 23,344.34. Memory throughput tests demonstrate uncached large-block read speeds of 119.7 GB/sec and write speeds of 55.79 GB/sec. Application testing records 23.48 million operations per second in Redis SET tasks and static web serving throughput of 14.04 GB/sec.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.g5ne.8xlarge lies in its lower single-threaded processing capability, requiring workloads to leverage parallel thread utilization across its 32 vCPUs to achieve efficiency. Because no local NVMe storage is included, storage operations depend entirely on network-attached volumes. The balanced memory-to-core allocation renders this instance suitable for general-purpose workloads such as static web serving, software compilation, multi-threaded database operations, and medium-scale backend processing.
